sections.body: Brand, theme and pages come from GET /site, so web and mobile stay in step without a redeploy of either.

about.title: About Cyber Scallywags
about.summary: A collective that builds open, well-tested software together.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Cyber Scallywags is a collective of builders sharing one way of starting projects, so every new idea begins tested, deployable and ready for others to join.

items.title: Ship small, ship often
items.body: Every change passes the same gate, from laptop to production.

items.title: Open by default
items.body: Templates, tests and decisions are written down for the next person.

items.title: Secure by design
items.body: Secrets stay out of git, and each service only reaches what it needs.

sections.heading: Join in
sections.body: Pick up an issue, propose a project, or bring this template to your own team.
